description: March 29 birthday meaning: Aries decan 1, birthday number 11, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a March 29 birthday falls in Aries, in the first decan, with Mars as the sign's ruler and Mars as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 11. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aries is cardinal and fire.

sections.heading: The March 29 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: March 29 keeps its master number 11, joining heightened intuition with the raw drive of early Aries, about eight degrees in. That is an unusual pairing: inspiration that arrives in flashes and an urge to act on it immediately. Readers often describe an inspired initiator who benefits from pausing just long enough to test a hunch.

Astronomically, March 29 puts the Sun near 8° Aries in most years, inside the first ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Mars. The opening stretch of Aries, from 0 to 9 degrees, is often called the purest expression of the sign, because Mars governs Aries and also acts as sub-ruler here. Astrologers traditionally picture this decan as the spark at the very start of the zodiac: quick to move, frank in speech and happiest with something to push against. The doubled Mars emphasis tends to sharpen courage and an appetite for challenge, and it can also shorten patience with slow processes. Many of these Rams recognise the urge to start before the plan is finished. Their growing edge is usually learning that a pause is not the same as a defeat.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for March 29
paragraphs: Born on the 29th, your compound is 2 + 9 = 11, and because 11 is a master number it is kept as 11 rather than reduced to 2. The 2 brings sensitivity, the 9 brings compassion and breadth, and together they create one of the most intuitive birthday numbers. People born on the 29th are often described as emotionally perceptive, idealistic and capable of inspiring others. Their feelings can run high, with marked highs and lows. As a secondary number, the 29 tends to reward creative and caring outlets for that intensity, and rest between them.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a March 29 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous March 29 birthdays
paragraphs: A March birthday falls around the spring equinox for the northern hemisphere, the season of thaw and first growth, while southern birthdays mark the turn into autumn. The month is split between Pisces and Aries, with the change around March 20 or 21. In numerology March is month 3, linked with expression, creativity and sociability, a lively number for a month that ends with the zodiac starting over. March 29 is the 88th day of the year (89th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Taurus, is usually complete within 22 days, by April 20.

By March 29 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a March 29 birthday are John Tyler (1790), John Major (1943) and Lavrentiy Beria (1899).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is March 29?
faq.answer: March 29 is Aries in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Aries, which tradition links with Mars.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on March 29?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On March 29 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 22 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 11 for everyone born on the 29th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on March 29?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by March 29, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on March 29?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on March 29 include John Tyler (1790), John Major (1943) and Lavrentiy Beria (1899). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
